coverage.summary: Applies in Portland. Private remedies are limited to owners of 16 or more units. The secondary source states no building, unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits on the prohibition itself.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owners of 16 or more units (private remedies only)

result.notes: The only source is a secondary summary table row (Morgan Lewis). The 16-unit threshold describes owner portfolio size, and the source ties it only to private remedies.
